caption:
Raising your ad budget feels like the obvious move.

But most service businesses take hours to answer a new lead. Every dollar of new spend feeds leads into that same gap. Your cost per booked job climbs even as your traffic grows.

Run this test before you increase spend: pull your leads-in count and your jobs-booked count for the last 30 days. A wide gap means the leak lives in the minutes after the lead lands.

Fix the follow-up. Then scale the ads.
